note: Player text for every queue ending, from the report's keys and counts. Kotlin owns the words (queueReportText in QueueReportText.kt) and QueueReportTextTest.kt checks every case; any other view of a report must show these same words.

cases.name: refused: not started from the app

text.title: Not started
text.reason: Not started, and nothing was spent: this start did not come from the Start button in UMA Auto+, or its launch choice changed after Start.
text.nextAction: Open UMA Auto+, press Start, then tap the overlay button.

cases.name: refused: settings did not reach the bot

text.title: Not started
text.reason: Not started, and nothing was spent: the settings UMA Auto+ checked when you pressed Start did not reach the bot.
text.nextAction: Force stop UMA Auto+ (Android Settings, Apps, UMA Auto+, Force stop), reopen it, turn its accessibility service back on if it was switched off, then press Start again.

text.title: Not started
text.reason: Not started, and nothing was spent: UMA Auto+ could not safely use its saved settings file.
text.nextAction: If your device's storage is full, free some space first. Then force stop UMA Auto+ (Android Settings, Apps, UMA Auto+, Force stop), reopen it, turn its accessibility service back on if it was switched off, and press Start again. When it opens, it checks the file again and restores it from the last good backup if it is damaged. If this message comes back, please report it as a bug.

text.title: Not started
text.reason: Not started, and nothing was spent: the rotation queue was not started from the Start button in UMA Auto+, so its trainee setups were not prepared.
text.nextAction: Open UMA Auto+, press Start, then tap the overlay button.
